bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: Quarterback Caleb Williams took a significant step toward returning from his hamstring injury, as he made a stride on Wednesday toward returning to the lineup for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons, being a full participant in the team's walkthrough. Despite this encouraging sign, it's the best sign yet that Williams will return after missing the past three weeks, though a walkthrough and a full practice are different, so his status will become clearer on Thursday.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions made headlines by cutting veteran safety Jalen Mills, a move described as part of a major defensive shakeup , while also seeing wide receiver Jameson Williams win his appeal to have a celebration fine rescinded. Heading into their bye week, the Lions sit just outside the Top 10 in this week's NFL power rankings , with reports also indicating they are expected to lose WR/returner Tom Kennedy to a season-ending injury .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest Packers story is the continued fallout from Javon Hargrave's season-ending torn Achilles, with Green Bay also "not anticipating" Micah Parsons will return this week as the team preps for a pivotal Sunday Night Football showdown against the Cowboys. Adding to the uncertainty, head coach Matt LaFleur said he has no update on when running back Josh Jacobs will be removed from the Commissioner Exempt List as the Packers try to extend their winning streak to three games.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings enter their Week 6 bye at a perfect 5-0 following a convincing 23-13 road win over the New Orleans Saints, with Justin Jefferson returning to make an immediate impact and Kyler Murray going 24-for-30 passing. With the trade deadline approaching, Minnesota is reportedly using the bye week to evaluate roster needs, including a workout with free agent receiver JuJu Smith-Schuster and speculation about trading disgruntled wideout Jauan Jennings.
